[Colorless][Colorless] Dragon Bind 20 — Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
[Fire][Lightning][Colorless] Twister 50 — Flip 2 coins. If both are tails, this attack does nothing. For each heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.
When Pokémon-ex has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
